plan.title: Rank Based Auction Shows Item-Level Vendor Rank

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow required for configuring auction strategy and awarding mode.
Configure a rank-based auction that may be partially awarded to multiple vendors.

args.goal: On the auction configuration screen, enable the control labeled "Show rank to vendor for individual item" and stop with the control visibly enabled

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated step for this configuration control, so perform the buyer-side on-screen action before continuing.
Apply the first available pricing template before adding line items.
Create several line items so item-level rank visibility can be observed.
Complete the pricing sheet for all line items.
Invite the QA vendor who will submit the bid.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the invited vendor session to verify the vendor-facing result.
Open the auction bid sheet in the supplier portal.
Submit a bid across the several line items.
Confirm the vendor screen exposes rank information after bidding, although the catalog cannot prove it is attached to every individual item.
